description: Buy what a quote priced (registration, renewal or transfer). You act for the person who connected you: when the workspace has a saved card and the amount is inside the agent spending limits (get_dashboard shows them), the card is charged at once and the order runs; the person is told. Otherwise (no card, over a limit, or pay_with "checkout") it returns a checkout_url and checkout_reason: give the link to the person to pay. The registrar call (and, for a registration, the DNS records you pass) then runs on its own. Poll get_order for the result. Nobody but a person can add or change the card.

accept_trademark_notice.description: true only after the person has read the trademark notice get_quote returned

dns.description: Records to create right after registration: a preset from list_dns_presets, optional records, or both.

target.description: Hostname the preset points www at, when the preset needs one; for dmarc, the email address that receives reports (optional, default dmarc@ the domain)

locale.description: Language of the page the person returns to after paying

pay_with.description: saved_card (default) charges the saved card within the agent limits; checkout always returns a link for the person

tld_requirements.description: Extra registry fields some country endings need (see get_tld_info)

name: purchase_domain
title: Buy a domain
